title: Flux-explicit Cheeger bounds for magnetic Laplacians on compact metric graphs
summary: Let (Γ) be a finite compact connected metric graph and let (A\in L^\infty(Γ)) be a real magnetic potential. The magnetic Laplacian (H_A) with standard vertex conditions is defined by the closed quadratic form [ q_A[u]=\sum_e\int_e |(-i\partial_x-A_e)u_e|^2,dx. ] A magnetic Cheeger constant is introduced by adding to the usual boundary term the frustration index of the potential on subgraphs. The first point of the paper is that, on a metric graph, this frustration index is exactly a finite dimensional (\ell^1) flux distance determined by the periods of (A) on cycles.
